## What does this change?


## Type
- [ ] New or changed content (pack, theme, card, voice lines)
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Engine or tooling change
- [ ] Docs

## Checklist
- [ ] `npm run validate`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] Tried in `npm run dev` with touch (a tablet or touch emulation)
- [ ] Art and sounds are generated in code, my own work, or CC0
- [ ] Every non-generated file has a row in ASSETS.md
- [ ] Nothing Minecraft-like and nothing scary
- [ ] New packs, themes and cards have lines in `voice/LINES.json`
- [ ] No reading required, no fail states, no network requests

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for details.
